text:
devon: Anyone know where the EU model-health + service-overview dashboards live? getting 403 when opening grafana shortlink.

maya: which link? can you paste the exact shortlink or screenshot?

devon: this one: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc123/model-health?orgId=1 — 403 forbidden in browser.

pradeep: if it's a 403 it's usually RBAC/org mismatch. grafana maps SSO groups to org roles. are you in eng-observability or svc-view?

devon: not sure how to check.

maya: devon you're not in eng-observability — I checked the group list. pinging infra to grant temporary view.

infra-bot: Access request created: INC-5432. Please include the dashboard shortlink and reason. Status: awaiting approver.

sarah: FYI we keep regional shortlinks in the ops wiki, but quick ones: https://short.redwood/dash/eu-models and https://short.redwood/dash/service-overview-eu

pradeep: heads up: model-health is in a different grafana org for EU; you need at minimum org role 'Viewer' + Loki read for logs. service-overview also surfaces traces which require 'svc-view' role to see Jaeger links.

devon: is there an easy way to test my grafana/Loki perms from terminal?

pradeep: yeah — use your grafana API key or cookie. Example:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $GF_TOKEN" https://grafana.redwood.internal/api/org
```
that will show your org and role. For Loki test:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $LOKI_TOKEN" "https://loki.redwood.internal/loki/api/v1/labels"
```
if you get 200 you have read access.

maya: i added devon to a temporary 'eng-obsv-temp' group expires in 24h. try again in ~5m and report if still 403.

devon: will try, thx :thumbsup:

maya: if still blocked, please paste the browser request-id header (x-request-id) and i'll escalate with infra on-call.

devon: got in! can see model-health + service-overview now. thanks all :tada:

pradeep: great — leaving a note to make the EU dashboards discoverable from the global dashboard index and add a line to the onboarding checklist about 'eng-observability' group.

maya: opened follow-up doc in ops: https://docs.redwood/internal/obs/region-dash-discovery

devon: closing the access request, niceday.
